parameters.query:
UPDATE demo_sessions SET messages_used = messages_used + 1
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND messages_used < 10
RETURNING id::text AS session_id,
          (10 - messages_used) AS messages_left

SELECT content, metadata, best_similarity
FROM demo_hybrid_search($1::text, $2::vector, $3::uuid, 8)

SELECT role, content FROM demo_messages
WHERE session_id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH m AS (
  INSERT INTO demo_messages (session_id, role, content)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, 'user', $2::text), ($1::uuid, 'assistant', $3::text)
)
UPDATE demo_sessions
SET input_tokens = input_tokens + $4::bigint,
    output_tokens = output_tokens + $5::bigint
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING $3::text AS answer

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ answer: $json.answer, messages_left: $('Claim Message Slot').first().json.messages_left, sources: $('Build Prompt').first().json.sources || [] }) }}
